'''''Salix myrsinifolia''''', known as the '''dark-leaved willow'''<ref name=BSBI07>{{BSBI 2007 |access-date=2014-10-17 }}</ref> or '''myrsine-leaved willow''',<ref>{{PLANTS|id=SAMY9|taxon=Salix myrsinifolia|accessdate=27 October 2015}}</ref> is a species of [[willow]] native to [[Europe]] and Western [[Siberia]]. It forms a {{convert|2|-|5|m|ft|abbr=on}}  high shrub. In the north, it often becomes a tree up to {{convert|8|m|ft|abbr=on}} tall.<ref>Väre H., Kiuru H., ''Suomen puut ja pensaat'' (''Trees and shrubs of Finland''), Metsäkustannus Oy, 2006.</ref>
